requirements.verifier_assertion: test_normal_exported_and_default_is_standard: scipy.stats.Normal exists; Normal() is standard normal with mean 0, variance 1, pdf(0)==1/sqrt(2*pi)
must_include: importable from the top level of scipy.stats

requirements.verifier_assertion: test_keyword_construction_and_parameter_attributes: mu/sigma keyword-only (positional raises TypeError); X.mu and X.sigma readable
test_pdf_logpdf_match_legacy_norm: pdf and logpdf match scipy.stats.norm at floating-point precision
test_cdf_two_argument_form: X.cdf(x, y) returns P(x <= X <= y), equal to cdf(y)-cdf(x)
test_inverse_cdf_functions_match_legacy: icdf matches norm.ppf, iccdf matches norm.isf, icdf(cdf(x)) round-trips to x
test_log_domain_inverses_deep_tail: ilogcdf/ilogccdf round-trip deep in the tail and stay finite at a log-probability of -700
test_moments_and_summary_statistics: mean/variance/std/skewness/kurtosis (default 3, excess 0), moment(order, kind) for raw/central/standardized
must_include: kurtosis of the normal distribution is 3

requirements.verifier_assertion: test_median_mode_entropy_logentropy: median and mode equal mu; entropy is the differential entropy; logentropy is its log
test_vectorized_parameters_broadcast: array parameters broadcast; (2,1) mu with (3,) sigma yields shape (2,3)
must_include: broadcast to the common parameter shape

requirements.verifier_assertion: test_invalid_parameters_yield_nan_not_raise: sigma <= 0 yields NaN per-position, not a whole-call exception; valid positions unaffected
must_include: NaN rather than the whole call raising an exception
only the invalid positions become NaN

requirements.verifier_assertion: test_sample_shape_and_reproducibility: sample(shape, rng) is reproducible under a fixed seed; array params give shape + broadcast shape
must_include: shape plus the parameter broadcast shape

requirements.verifier_assertion: test_sample_statistics_close_to_parameters: empirical mean and std of a large sample track mu and sigma
must_include: empirical mean is close to mu
empirical standard deviation is close to sigma
